doc: Worker task classes with evidence-backed local-vs-frontier equivalence records. Measured under benchmarks/speed_offload/PREREG.md; consumed by z0int.speed_offload (shadow).

evidence_sufficiency.description: Three-way judgement: does the evidence support, contradict, or not establish a claim.

extract_json.description: Extract named fields from a tool output or receipt into a JSON object.

classify_file_type.description: Classify the file type / language of a file excerpt (tool Read output).

summarize_tool_output.description: Summarize a tool output (git, logs, diffs) under a word limit, keeping key facts.

short_rewrite.description: Rewrite a sentence under a word limit, preserving code spans verbatim.
